mapper.sql: SELECT U.USER_SN, U.USER_ID, U.USER_NM, U.USER_ENPSWD, U.OGDP_BZENTY_NM, U.DEPT_NM, U.TELNO, U.EML_ADDR, U.USER_STTS_NM, U.PSWD_EXPRY_YMD, U.LAST_LGN_DT, U.LGN_FAIL_NOCS, U.USE_YN, U.REG_DT, U.MDFCN_DT, A.AUTHRT_SN, A.AUTHRT_NM FROM user_info U LEFT JOIN user_authrt_rel R ON R.USER_SN = U.USER_SN AND R.AUTHRT_BGNG_DT <= NOW() AND (R.AUTHRT_END_DT IS NULL OR R.AUTHRT_END_DT > NOW()) LEFT JOIN authrt_info A ON A.AUTHRT_SN = R.AUTHRT_SN AND A.USE_YN = 'Y' AND A.AUTHRT_STTS_NM = '사용'
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_info WHERE USER_ID = #{_parameter}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_info (USER_ID, USER_NM, USER_ENPSWD, OGDP_BZENTY_NM, DEPT_NM, TELNO, EML_ADDR, USER_STTS_NM, PSWD_EXPRY_YMD, LGN_FAIL_NOCS, USE_YN, RGTR_SN) VALUES (#{userId}, #{userNm}, #{userEnpswd}, #{ogdpBzentyNm}, #{deptNm}, #{telno}, #{emlAddr}, #{userSttsNm}, DATE_ADD(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 90 DAY), 0, #{useYn}, #{rgtrSn})
INSERT INTO user_authrt_rel (USER_SN, AUTHRT_SN, AUTHRT_BGNG_DT) VALUES (#{userSn}, #{authrtSn}, NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE user_info SET USER_NM = #{userNm}, OGDP_BZENTY_NM = #{ogdpBzentyNm}, DEPT_NM = #{deptNm}, TELNO = #{telno}, EML_ADDR = #{emlAddr}, USER_STTS_NM = #{userSttsNm}, USE_YN = #{useYn}, MDFCN_DT = NOW(), MDFR_SN = #{mdfrSn} WHERE USER_SN = #{userSn} AND USE_YN != 'N'
UPDATE user_info SET USER_ENPSWD = #{userEnpswd}, PSWD_EXPRY_YMD = DATE_ADD(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 90 DAY), MDFCN_DT = NOW(), MDFR_SN = #{mdfrSn} WHERE USER_SN = #{userSn} AND USE_YN != 'N'
UPDATE user_info SET USE_YN = 'N', USER_STTS_NM = '삭제', MDFCN_DT = NOW(), MDFR_SN = #{mdfrSn} WHERE USER_SN = #{userSn} AND USE_YN != 'N'
UPDATE user_info SET USER_STTS_NM = '정상', LGN_FAIL_NOCS = 0, MDFCN_DT = NOW(), MDFR_SN = #{mdfrSn} WHERE USER_SN = #{userSn} AND USE_YN = 'Y' AND USER_STTS_NM = '잠금'
UPDATE user_info SET LGN_FAIL_NOCS = LGN_FAIL_NOCS + 1, USER_STTS_NM = CASE WHEN LGN_FAIL_NOCS + 1 >= 5 THEN '잠금' ELSE USER_STTS_NM END WHERE USER_SN = #{_parameter}
UPDATE user_info SET LGN_FAIL_NOCS = 0, LAST_LGN_DT = NOW() WHERE USER_SN = #{_parameter}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cntn_log (USER_SN, USER_ID, LGN_IP_ADDR, CNTN_BGNG_DT, CNTN_BRWSR_NM, CNTN_YN, FAIL_RSN) VALUES (#{userSn}, #{userId}, #{loginIp}, NOW(), #{browserNm}, #{loginSuccessYn}, #{failRsn})
mapper.update: UPDATE cntn_log SET LGT_DT = NOW() WHERE USER_SN = #{_parameter} AND CNTN_YN = 'Y' AND LGT_DT IS NULL ORDER BY CNTN_BGNG_DT DESC LIMIT 1
